title: Retrieve Villager Trades — villager_trades
text: Minecraft trade tables follow tier -> group -> trade. Explicit Mojang item choices create separate base rows wants gives field remains single value. expanded = FALSE, generated details remain collapsed base row. example, Librarian enchanted-book row describes full emerald range without naming one enchantment price. probability chance base item combination appears, marginal every function outcome. pinned tables contain 281 compact rows across professions. expanded = TRUE, reconstructable function outcome exact price receives row option_id. Repeated trade_id values remain alternatives one source trade; additional candidates group. pinned tables contain 30,592 expanded rows. Apart unresolved color random_dye, every populated quantity minimum equals maximum. Fixed potion exploration-map functions resolve one value either form create alternative outcomes. random_dye reconstructed faithfully pinned sources remains one partial expanded row.

title: Retrieve Villager Trades — villager_trades
text: offer_probability (double) marginal chance displayed row appears among villager's offers. group selecting k n applicable source entries gives ordinary source trade probability k / n; select-groups give every source trade probability one. Identical source entries treated repeated ways obtain trade. Explicit choices expanded function outcomes contribute conditional probabilities. Rows generally sum one. tier can contain several groups can therefore add several offers. compact row's probability marginal details collapses. expanded row instead gives joint probability exact displayed items, specifications, price. Summing expanded probabilities one base item-choice combination recovers compact probability. probability_status (character) describes calculation: "exact" covers source-table selection, explicit choices, legacy data-value outcomes, fixed potions, maps. "documented_model" covers Librarian books complete enchanted equipment sets. "partial" marks random_dye, whose exact leather-color distribution established pinned sources.

title: Retrieve Villager Trades — villager_trades
text: Librarian book trade draws uniformly 39 eligible enchantments, draws uniformly selected enchantment's valid levels. gives 116 enchantment-level combinations. Soul Speed, Swift Sneak, Wind Burst excluded. enchantment level L, pinned parameters produce normal emerald price 2 + 3L + U, U discrete uniform integer zero 4 + 10L.
